title: AI Animation - Struggling to find a good option
author: Shnatrix
selftext:
Hey guys,

I'm building a game for fun using replit, loving the process of building and playing the game.

I am however struggling with animation, it's a pixel game, so trying to get a nice animation going, I've looked at a few options - but nothing is quite able to get that look right. 

I'm asking if anyone has had success with what I'm aiming for and what they've used.

Think - Moonstone Island, Potion Permit for modern and Pokemon and FF series for older.

comments.author: gl0balist
comments.body: There are a couple of options that I saved but never tried - pixellab ai and retro diffusion.

replies.author: pan_anu
replies.body: Waste of time and money, at least the pixel lab

replies.author: Shnatrix
replies.body: I've found pixel was sort of valuable for doing scuttle and bits and pieces but animation wasn't brilliant

comments.author: macuseri686
comments.body:
[Https://gamelabstudio.co](Https://gamelabstudio.co)

It’s the full workflow from concept description or reference images to animation to sprite sheet. And it keeps coherence between all the different angles and animation actions you have for a given unit. Plus it also has integration directly into VSCode if you want to control it through the AI agent

I’ve personally used it to build [Age of Steam Tower Defence](https://ageofsteamtd.com)

replies.author: chonky_totoro
replies.body: that's your own tool, and your pricing is fucking atrocious.

replies.author: macuseri686
replies.body:
Yes, I built that tool out of necessity when I was working on age of steam.

My pricing is very close to cost actually within a few percent of what it actually costs me to pay for the models to render the animations. Some of the pricing levels I actually lose money if you render all the animations.

What is atrocious about the pricing in your opinion?

replies.author: chonky_totoro
replies.body: what apis are you using and how many calls are you making for you to charge so much? something is not efficient here

replies.author: macuseri686
replies.body:
Google VEO 3 api for animations. Just 1 api call per animation rendered.

https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/pricing

replies.author: chonky_totoro
replies.body: and im guessing nano banana to make the background transparent

replies.author: macuseri686
replies.body: Nope. Nano banana cannot make the background transparent. It cannot output alpha transparency at all. The background removal process is my own personal code

replies.author: macuseri686
replies.body:
The tool allows you to vibe code by connecting to it as an MCP server in your code editor.

If you’re asking whether I vibe coded this platform. No. I’m a software developer with over 15+ years in the industry. I know a thing or 2 about coding

replies.author: chonky_totoro
replies.body: i am curious if you manually coded the transparency removal or if you had ai code it or help you code it

replies.author: macuseri686
replies.body: I wrote the system myself.  It includes a chroma key in the workflow as the animation is generated. I use  ffmpeg on the backend to extract the frames from the video, crop and transform them to the resolution needed and then using the pillow library, I wrote a number of proprietary functions to cleanup the edges around the subject using a color threshold and pixel radius search

replies.author: chonky_totoro
replies.body: thank you for the information. i will attempt to replicate something similar. i would use your service but it doesnt fit the game im making

replies.author: macuseri686
replies.body: Glad to be of help :) . Can I ask what doesn’t fit about my service? It should work for any art style

comments.author: MHZ-Dev
comments.body: There is basically nothing. You'll get kind of close but it still doesn't look great and it will show. Id recommend just using placeholders from itch or generating pixel art and using unfaker and then animating yourself. It's pretty fun to learn. Then later on either buy an asset pack or get someone to animate what you generated. This will give you the best results.
